description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_URI' class, representing an internal data structure for handling and validating URIs within the HTML Purifier library. It includes properties for URI components, methods for validation, conversion to string, and scheme management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URI
classes.description: Represents a URI with components such as scheme, userinfo, host, port, path, query, and fragment, along with methods to validate, normalize, and output the URI.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes URI components, normalizing scheme and port.

methods.name: getSchemeObj
methods.description: Retrieves an appropriate scheme object for validation based on the URI's scheme, configuration, and context.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation and normalization of URI components based on RFC 3986 rules.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Reconstructs the URI string from its components for output.

methods.name: isLocal
methods.description: Checks if the URI is considered local based on the host and current configuration.

methods.name: isBenign
methods.description: Determines if the URI is benign, i.e., local and with an acceptable security level.
